private fun getTargetType(call: UCallExpression, context: JavaContext): PsiType? {
    val parent = call.uastParent ?: return null
    return when (parent) {
        is UVariable -> parent.type
        is UBinaryExpression -> {
            if (parent.operator == UastBinaryOperator.ASSIGN) {
                parent.leftOperand.getExpressionType()
            } else null
        }
        is UTypeCastExpression -> null // already cast
        is UReturnExpression -> {
            val method = parent.getParentOfType(UMethod::class.java, true) ?: return null
            method.returnType
        }
        is UCallExpression -> {
            // argument to another call
            val args = parent.valueArguments
            val index = args.indexOf(call)
            if (index >= 0) {
                context.evaluator.getParameterType(parent, index)
            } else null
        }
        else -> null
    }
}
```
